description: This file contains functions for installing and configuring AdvancedOpenDiscovery (AOD) features within the SuiteCRM environment. It defines setup routines that enable or disable AOD, and installs necessary logic hooks related to AOD index changes.

methods.name: install_aod
methods.description: Initializes AOD settings by disabling the feature and saving configuration, then sets up associated hooks.

methods.name: installAODHooks
methods.description: Loads hook definitions for AOD and registers them with the system using check_logic_hook_file.
